claims.text: The ensemble model achieves the best performance for predicting both implicit and explicit discourse relations simultaneously.
The paragraph-level neural network model achieves the best macro-average F1-score of 48.82% in predicting implicit discourse relations, outperforming previous models.
Explicit discourse relations have achieved reasonable performance with F1 scores greater than 90%, while implicit relations are more challenging to identify.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing minority discourse relations, particularly in the Comparison and Temporal categories.
